export.title: Export your data
export.description: Downloads one zip with every job, resume, task, activity and question on this account, plus your uploaded resume files.
export.contents: The file contains no API keys and no password, so it is safe to store anywhere. It does contain the full text of every job description, note and resume.

import.title: Import a backup
import.description: Replaces everything on this account with the contents of the backup. Your API keys are left alone; the agent chat history is cleared.
import.differentAccount: This backup came from a different account ({email}). Importing it will still wipe the account you are signed in to.
import.replace: Replace my data with this backup

undo.title: Undo an import
undo.description: Every import saves your previous data first. If you imported the wrong file, restore the snapshot from just before it.

rollbackDialog.title: Roll back to this snapshot?
rollbackDialog.description: Everything on this account will be replaced with the data from {date}. A snapshot of the current state is saved first, so this is itself undoable.

importDialog.title: Delete this account's data?
importDialog.intro: This cannot be undone. The following will be permanently deleted and replaced with the backup's contents:
importDialog.differentAccount: The backup is from a different account.
